source_relationship.direction: for created and restored wetlands, VERY suitable land lies within about 500 m of a frequently flowing stream; cost and energy rise in buffer steps beyond it (the paper's one-hundred-and-fifty-metre buffers), and land above the highest point where water flows frequently is unsuitable without pumping
